description: Blacklight north shell restricted facilities records covering Black-level housing, operative and mercenary quarters, roof helicopter access, armory fabrication, supernatural containment, relic vault architecture, and B-series above-Black security levels.

entries.title: North Shell Restricted Facility Program
entries.summary: The north shell is a fully Black-level facility band containing long-term operative housing, mercenary support quarters, armory fabrication, containment cells, roof aviation access, and high-security vault architecture.
entries.clearance: BLACK CARD. Green access is task-scoped only; B-series compartments require above-Black authority.
entries.informationRating: IR-4: Black facility program with IR-5 attachments for vault, containment, Charles-sealed, and B-series material.
entries.sourceCredibility: CR-A: Security Operations access map corroborated by Black Archive custody records, Facilities route controls, and board-sealed infrastructure notes.
entries.recordStatus: Active north shell restricted facility scope record.
entries.maintainedBy: Black Archive Custodians, Security Operations, Facilities and Workplace Services, and Board Secretariat.
body: The north side facilities are not partially restricted or merely executive secure. The north shell is completely blocked to Black-level access by default. It is the facility band where Blacklight stops pretending that high-security contracts are the whole reason for the building's unusual infrastructure. The public corporation remains visible elsewhere; the north shell concentrates the infrastructure that makes the hidden Company operationally survivable.

The north shell contains long-term mercenary and operative housing, long-term housing for at least a dozen operatives, armory fabrication areas, supernatural containment cells, roof helicopter access, an extensive armory, a high-security vault complex, and a relic vault capable of holding roughly one hundred individually contained and sectioned vault containers. This is not a decorative executive wing. It is a logistics, custody, containment, deployment, and survival machine built into the side of a corporate headquarters.

Green personnel may see parts of the north shell only through narrow support orders: a blocked elevator landing, a sealed work panel, a special procurement delivery, a maintenance corridor, an emergency air handler, a vault climate-control issue, or a roof access service call. They are not told the complete program unless Black authority decides the task cannot be performed safely without a narrow briefing.
keyFacts: The north shell is Black-level access by default.
It contains long-term housing for operative and mercenary personnel.
It includes armory fabrication, an extensive armory, a vault complex, supernatural containment, and roof helicopter access.
The supernatural containment block has eight cells rated for entities up to approximately power level seven.
The relic vault has capacity for roughly one hundred individually contained vault containers, including twenty low-security lockers and ten highest-security Black-card vault-door chambers.
Above-Black B-series levels exist for intelligence and items that exceed ordinary Black-card handling.

entries.summary: The north shell contains long-term housing for at least a dozen operatives, with additional quarters for mercenary or contracted support personnel who cannot safely be placed in ordinary corporate lodging.

body: North shell housing exists because Blacklight sometimes needs people on site who are not ordinary employees, visitors, or short-term guests. Some are operatives under long-term assignment. Some are contracted mercenary or protection personnel. Some are medically, politically, legally, or supernaturally complicated enough that normal hotels and ordinary corporate apartments would create more risk than comfort.

The housing block is designed for duration rather than prestige. It must support sleep, hygiene, personal storage, secure communications, medical observation, gear staging, psychological decompression, and quick movement toward armory, vault, roof access, or facility-response routes. Housing at this clearance level is not a perk. It is a containment-adjacent continuity tool for people Blacklight cannot easily send home.

At least a dozen operative beds or rooms are maintained as a standing capacity expectation. Additional mercenary or contracted-force housing may be activated as mission load, threat level, board action, or long-duration facility mode requires. Green staff may service air, water, locks, sanitation, supply routing, and emergency repairs, but should not be given resident identities unless the task requires it.

body: The north shell armory is not a single weapons room. It is an integrated armory, fabrication, repair, custody, and deployment support complex. It supports ordinary security equipment, operative field gear, specialized anti-entity tools, restricted ammunition, protective systems, containment-support devices, and relic-adjacent equipment that must not pass through ordinary procurement or maintenance channels without explanation.

Fabrication areas exist so Blacklight can repair, adapt, isolate, or produce mission-critical hardware without waiting for public vendors to understand the assignment. The visible explanation is secure client equipment support and high-trust prototype maintenance. The Black-level function is more direct: if an operation requires a weapon, bracket, cage component, warded case, signal isolator, armor patch, drone mount, helicopter-ready crate, or containment-rated tool by morning, the north shell is where the company tries to make that possible.

Roof helicopter access connects the north shell to movement the public building cannot absorb. It supports medical extraction, operative departure, secure delivery, high-risk arrival, weather-limited access, and emergency relocation. Roof access is physically tied to route discipline: if a person, item, or entity-adjacent container cannot move through the lobby, the roof and north shell become the cleaner path.

entries.summary: The north shell contains eight supernatural containment cells rated for entities up to approximately power level seven, with Black-level custody and B-series escalation where containment exceeds ordinary Black handling.

body: The north shell containment block contains eight supernatural containment cells. The standing design target is containment of entities up to approximately power level seven, assuming the entity class matches the cell's intended control profile and the facility has not been compromised by signal, invitation, atmospheric, or information-hazard failure. Power level seven is a planning ceiling, not a promise that every level-seven event can be solved by closing a door.

Each cell is treated as a layered system: physical wall, door, seal, observation limit, air and pressure behavior, power independence, communication restriction, emergency feed route, waste and evidence handling, and post-containment review. A cell may be technically capable of holding an entity and still be the wrong place to hold that entity if guest-law, spirit territory, fae invitation, machine influence, or relic interaction changes the rules.

Green support is dangerous around containment because Green personnel may be close enough to maintain air, power, water, doors, and sensor routes without understanding what is inside. Green work orders must never use cute language or vague hazard categories. They should specify panel, route, lock state, protective gear, remote check-in, stop condition, and whether the cell is occupied, dormant, empty, or status-withheld.

body: The north shell relic vault is built around roughly one hundred individually contained and sectioned vault containers. The point of the design is not simply storage. It is separation. Items that share a room may still need separate air, signal silence, symbolic isolation, vibration control, observation limits, pressure rules, temperature bands, custody logs, and door authorities because the danger may be the item, the memory of the item, the thing attached to the item, or the idea that someone knows the item is present.

The first twenty containers are low-security lockers by vault standards. Low security does not mean harmless. It means Blacklight believes the object can be handled through ordinary Black-card chain of custody, standard isolation, and documented access. Above those lockers, the vault gradually increases in isolation, lock strength, access review, environmental separation, and remote seal authority.

At the high end, ten vault containers are high-security vault-door chambers with Black-card access only, electronic locks, and remotely sealed doors. Responsible opening authority for those highest-security doors rests with Charles or board members under recorded conditions. In practice, these chambers are where Blacklight admits that Black-card access is not always enough. Some items require B-series restriction above Black.

entries.summary: Above Black, Blacklight uses B1 through B5 restrictions for intelligence and items too dangerous for ordinary Black-card access, with B5 reserved for Eva Frost and Charles only.

body: Black-card access is the highest visible card level. It is not the highest security level Blacklight uses. Above Black, the B-series exists for intelligence, relics, entities, sealed records, and items that cannot be safely handled by ordinary Black-card personnel simply because they hold Black cards. These levels are not printed as ordinary badges. They are allowances, exceptions, sealed permissions, and active recognitions attached to a person, record, item, or incident.

The B-series runs from B1 through B5. B1 is the widest above-Black ring: selected Black-card personnel may receive narrow access to a specific item, chamber, record, or briefing. Each step inward becomes whiter, colder, and less populated: fewer people, fewer explanations, fewer assumptions that rank or bravery are enough. B5 is the innermost ring, reserved for Eva Frost and Charles only.

B-series restrictions may apply to relic vault containers, containment cases, Charles-specific records, board-sealed intelligence, active existential threats, items that alter memory or source credibility, and information that becomes dangerous merely by being fully understood. A B-series mark is a warning that normal Black-level confidence has reached its limit.

tables.title: B-Series Access Bands
rows: B1
Selected Black-card personnel with specific need, time limit, and custody record.
Narrow access to one vault container, containment issue, sealed briefing, or restricted object.
B2
Small named cell of Black authorities, usually with board or Charles awareness.
High-risk relics, sensitive intelligence, dangerous technical interpretation, or active containment support.
B3
Board-adjacent or Charles-adjacent authorization; access rarely portable between cases.
Items or records that affect source credibility, memory, command authority, or facility trust.
B4
Near-core sealed authority with extremely limited human access.
Board-sealed intelligence, existentially sensitive relics, high-consequence entity attachments, or catastrophic disclosure risk.
B5
Eva Frost and Charles only.
Security-level intelligence and items that cannot be delegated without changing the threat itself.
